# Brew Babes

> Coffee equipment discovery with product-specific specifications, drink menus and configuration comparisons. Purchases and fulfillment are handled by Upscale Coffee.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://selleryd.github.io/brew-babes/): Discover the collection.
- [Complete coffee equipment collection](https://selleryd.github.io/brew-babes/shop/): All listed products exceed $500.
- [Structured product facts](https://selleryd.github.io/brew-babes/catalog.json): Listed configurations, prices, specifications, preparations and source references.
- [Sitemap](https://selleryd.github.io/brew-babes/sitemap.xml): Canonical product URLs.

## Scope
Each profile refers to its listed model family and configuration. Some drink lists are manual recipes rather than one-touch programs; the page explains the preparation mode. Final prices, stock, delivery and warranty terms are confirmed by Upscale Coffee.
